cases.prompt: Design a production-safe smoke check for this deploy: read-only probes and what not to touch.

assertions: Enumerate candidate checks and classify each as read-only, reversible, seeded-fixture-only, or unsafe/forbidden.
Returns the structured record above and does not edit code or claim unrun evidence.

cases.prompt: What can we safely verify after deploy without creating real orders?

assertions: Choose the smallest safe set that proves the deploy; prefer GET/health/version/read-only queries.
Chosen probes with expected observables and evidence.
Returns the structured record above and does not edit code or claim unrun evidence.

cases.prompt: Our smoke test writes data - redesign it as read-only or seeded-fixture checks with evidence.

assertions: For each check define the probe, expected observable, evidence to record and stop condition.
Returns the structured record above and does not edit code or claim unrun evidence.

cases.prompt: Design synthetic monitoring and alerting for this user journey.

assertions: Routes to synthetic-monitoring-architect; this skill does not perform that neighbouring owner's work.
Does not claim to have run any inspection or execution it did not run.

cases.prompt: The only health endpoint is cached by the CDN and one probe needs a read-only service credential we do not have - design the safest smoke plan and state what each probe proves.

assertions: Classify every probe as read-only, seeded-fixture-only or forbidden; state what a cached/synthetic health endpoint actually proves.
Record permissions/credential authority and the gaps when a read-only check cannot run.
Return the plan with unexercised areas and stop conditions; keep execution delegated.

cases.prompt: Production looks broken after the deploy - run these probes now and tell me if it is healthy.

assertions: Refuses to execute production probes and returns the plan for the authorized host/user.
Routes a live post-deploy health determination to the manual-only observability-operator and live-failure diagnosis to systematic-debugger.
Does not claim a production check, probe execution or health determination.
